To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we propose a novel software/hardware architecture to accelerate the analysis of raw data in a real-time fashion, and that the architecture can achieve > 20x speedup and 1000x energy efficiency over a CPU-based approach.
the proposed approach can accelerate data analytics on raw data and outperform the state-of-art data analytics system on loaded data.

the UDP is a new architecture that is 1000x energy efficient and 100x less expensive than CPU for data transformation, and that the ACCORDA is a new analytical system that can process raw data at the same speed as loaded data.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and implementation of a unified hardware/software system to accelerate data analysis on raw data in real time.
the efficient analysis of raw data in native formats in real-time.
the acceleration of raw data analysis and the seamless integration of raw data processing into analytical systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we propose to develop the first general-purpose hardware accelerator for data transformation, and a software framework for seamless integration of the hardware acceleration into analytical systems.
this thesis makes a significant contribution to the field of big data analytics.
this research will enable the extreme acceleration of raw data analytics, which will be the first of its kind, to the best of our knowledge.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the UTA and ATO together enable real-time decision-making and fast knowledge exploration for raw data.

this thesis will contribute to the research community in three ways: 1) a novel hardware accelerator for data analytics, the Unstructured data Processor (UDP), 2) the Accelerated Transformation Operators (ATO) framework for integrating the UDP into analytical systems, and 3) the ACCORDA analytical system that integrates the ATO and the UDP for extreme acceleration and seamless integration of raw data analysis.
we propose a novel architecture and a novel software framework to accelerate data analytics in the era of big data.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed approach can enable the efficient processing of raw data in real-time and can accelerate the analysis of data from new sources.
raw data analytics can be accelerated to match or even outperform the performance of structured analytical systems.
the combination of hardware acceleration and software integration enables a new class of raw data analytical system, which can deliver real-time decision making for big data analytics.
